item.title: Binance Launches Agent OS to Connect AI With Financial Tools
item.summary: Binance has launched Binance Agent OS, a developer platform designed to connect artificial intelligence applications directly with its financial infrastructure. Announced on Aug. 20, 2026, the platform provides AI agents with a standardized access layer to Binance trading systems, market data, wallets, payment services, and on-chain tools.
